name: Tokapuchi 400
why: Hokkaidō's big-sky ride: the widest farmland in Japan, almost no traffic, the mountains on the horizon all the way round
note: National cycle route round the Tokachi plain, 403 km signed; our loop 338 km · north through Kamishihoro and Ashoro to Ikeda, then the Pacific coast: Urahoro, Hiroo, back up through Nakasatsunai · grassland, dairy farms, straight empty roads · get to Obihiro by the Sapporo leg or the train
forkSummary: Main line · South: Hiroo and the Pacific coast
